Download **AutobahnRush.apk** below, open it on your Android phone and allow installing apps from this source when asked.

- Career: earn euros every run and unlock cars and paint in the garage
- Daily missions with bonus money
- 9 languages, picked from your phone's language (change it in Settings)
- First-run tutorial, Battery saver graphics, error report in Settings
- Optional ads: double a run's money, waive a speed-camera fine; "remove ads" purchase (when set up in Play)
- Google Play Games leaderboards and achievements (once configured)

If no release key is configured yet (see docs/ANDROID.md), the APK is debug-signed and an update may need the old version uninstalled first.
